project: Member C common representation, pretrained memory initializer and state/evaluation interface supporting the sleep and selective Hebbian tracks
scope: Memory-component positive control, not complete Titans/byte language model or teammate method implementation

representation.decoder: first16 raw coordinates, no learned classifier
representation.population: All64 IDs appear in training; evaluate independently sampled whole histories/compositions, not unseen individual key/value pairs. Exclude exact ordered training histories, but local subsets can recur.

methods.delta: Exact linear half-sum-SSE gradient update, step1, zero initial matrix and no decay. Orthogonal slots make exact retention a construction-based plumbing control, not a learned or sleep advantage.
methods.neural: Vendored NeuralMemory with two-layer64→128→64 MemoryMLP, fixed identity q/k/v, no norms/momentum/residual/read gate, half-sum-SSE inner loss, fixed step .5 or1. Only initial memory matrices are outer-trained; last initial matrix zero. Frozen decay logit-80 rounds1-decay to1 in float32. No upstream edits.

training.objective: Mean squared read-coordinate error against16-way one-hot target, supervised all initial queried keys
training.episodes: K sampled from2/4/8; half batches revise max(1,K/4) keys; D0/4 outside-key distractors. Initial/final queried values distinct. New independent compositions every episode. Same actual arrays for all seeds/configs.
training.checkpoint: Fixed final only; initial initializer also saved/evaluated, no best-checkpoint selection

qualification.selection: Try step .5 for BOTH original seeds. If either fails, try step1 for BOTH original seeds at the identical budget. Choose first config passing all gates in both seeds; retain all trials. No best-seed selection.
qualification.uncertainty: For rolled-memory admission, resample cyclic roll blocks of16 episodes,5000draws seed90304. Other paired contrasts resample whole independent episodes.
qualification.confirmation: Evaluate selected configuration BOTH seeds on fresh development seed90313; both must pass the same rules before pressure. Confirmation is development validation, not an untouched final test.

pressure.online_prefill: K facts then revisions of positions2/3, identical online-only prefill in every arm. Export/save/load/import memory at boundary.
pressure.targets: Two stable positions0/1 and two revised2/3 have distinct final values; optional recent distractor. They differ in age and FIFO residency, so compare schedules within stratum, not cross-stratum revision cost.
pressure.distractors: Keys outside all initial K, sampled with replacement from64-K choices, fixed value per distractor key; no target is reobserved during delay.
pressure.replay: Latest-per-key FIFO8; real repeated keys/revisions refresh FIFO age. At each four-arrival delay-block start, sample4 with replacement from already observed buffer. Continuous inserts each sampled pair after its arrival; periodic inserts identical samples in identical order at block end. Repeat-current matches4 extra updates without a buffer. All use identical write rules/gates; no decay suppression.
pressure.budgets: Prefill K+2. Online lower-budget anchor K+2+D writes; repeat/continuous/periodic K+2+2D writes. Boundary reset executes prefill then discards its fast state before D observations; separate diagnostic.
pressure.storage: Report actual unique backing tensor storage including aux and scan views, before/after serialization and peak post-write; fixed slow/codebook tensors separately. Replay policy max8 working pairs+4 frozen selections; logical pairs are not Python physical memory. Saved traces are evaluator-only and not read inputs.
pressure.claim_gate: Only selected, confirmed neural models enter pressure. Per-K D0 acquisition must also be adequate before a delay result is called retention. Delta always runs full protocol as exact plumbing control.

state_contract: Read receives only query keys and fast state. Payload contains method/config/fingerprint/counter/weights/aux, no raw history or labels. Slow parameters frozen throughout evaluation; reads pure; session roundtrip exact.
limitations: Typed vocab/coordinates explicitly remove parsing/encoder/readout learning; no unseen-key, language, paper-faithfulness, sleep or Hebbian novelty claim. Initialization selection is development tuning; revision/session requirements still apply to future full-model integration.
